Join Us

Become a Volunteer or Partner

Here, you can participate in planning and organizing person-centered events, helping more people learn and experience the power of being person-centered. If you are interested in joining our volunteer team or collaborating more deeply, please fill out the application form below or contact us directly.

What can you do?

  • Assist with conferences, forums, workshops: event services, translation, reception, etc.
  • Help execute and manage projects under our Person-Centered Incubator
  • Provide writing or design support for our journals or publicity
  • Any other areas you are interested in (we welcome fresh ideas)

How to apply?

1. Fill out the application form:
2. Send an email: Alternatively, you can email your brief introduction, areas of interest, and available time to info@pcia.asia
3. Wait for our volunteer coordinator to respond. Once confirmed, you can join our team.
